scenarios.requirement: No source sets a feature macro of its own: configure writes them into config.h
The write-owner test compiles because config.h carries the feature macros, and fails without them
A name of NetBSD's longest NAME_MAX fits the path owner's limit
nm -u is read the same in GNU, bare-U and OpenBSD's name-only format
An undeclared function is an error on every compiler: Makefile.am does not hide it and the probed flag wins over a compiler that only warns
The -Wno- flags configure chose are known to the compiler in use (no unknown warning option)
A file size is printed as a long long
configure names libm for floor and ceil where the linker does not find them through another library
A job an interrupt cuts keeps the junit of every row it finished, so the gate still reads what ran
A shard the job cuts keeps the 124 of the cut and the junit of every row it finished
The gate reads a cut shard and names the rows it never ran
A shard is cut with its grace and keeps its junit whatever cut program the image ships
A run that ends before its deadline keeps its own exit status and the report says it was not cut
A run starts with the default interrupt and an empty signal mask whatever its parent ignored
A run whose parent ignored the interrupt is still cut and takes it
The cut reaches the run's own process only, never a worker that is ended by it
A cut pytest run in workers keeps its junit and no row in flight is written as crashed
A run that ignores the cut is killed at the grace with exit 137 and the report names what did not end
Nothing of a killed run is left, whatever process group it is in
A run that dies of a signal of its own before the deadline is not read as a cut
A signal to the cut tool cuts its run with the full grace and the junit is kept
A run does not outlive a cut tool that was killed
A duration that is no deadline is refused and nothing is run
A command that is not there ends 127 as a shell says
The cut of a run holding an editor ends the editor
A run that keeps forking while it is killed is ended within a bound and nothing of it is left
The kill gives up after its bound and names what it could not end
A run gets every cut signal at its default and an empty mask whatever the tool inherited
